meta: Why does AI text appear bit by bit? It's not for show: that's called streaming. The wait before the first word is called latency.

muc.title: Text appears bit by bit
muc.text: AI text appears bit by bit as if it were typing, and that's not for show. This is called streaming.

muc.title: Guessing piece by piece
muc.text: AI predicts one piece of text at a time, so the app sends you each piece as soon as it's ready.

muc.title: Waiting for the first word
muc.text: Latency is the delay from pressing send until the first word appears. Heavy files mean a longer wait.

muc.title: Longer wait, better answer
muc.text: Thinking modes take longer because AI drafts a solution first, but they do better on hard problems.

muc.title: Stop halfway
muc.text: When AI goes off topic, hit stop and fix your question instead of waiting for the whole answer.

thu: When AI goes off topic, hit stop and fix your question instead of waiting for the whole answer.
